title: Removing tiny frictions
summary: Frictions add up. The Life Admin System takes them away.
content:
This is a tiny thing that gave me joy this morning.

It's dry here. So I should moisturise. But I forget.

I have 240 tasks in Things. It'd be a cluttered, stressful shambles without my Life Admin System. But it isn't.

I knew, when adding this task, that there was already a place for it. Is that a tiny win? Yes. Do they compound? They do.
